dedupe_keys.name: usgs world minerals outlook to 2029 production capacity data cobalt gallium helium lithium magnesium pgms titanium

description: This U.S. Geological Survey data release gives estimated country-level production capacity for cobalt, gallium, helium, lithium, magnesium, palladium, platinum and titanium for 2024 to 2029, with production from 2018 to 2024 so that capacity utilisation can be seen. The ScienceBase page says capacity can limit future supply depending on how fast it expands, and links the companion Scientific Investigations Report 2025-5021 by Alonso and co-authors. It was published on 11 March 2025 by Elisa Alonso, Amanda Brioche, Ruth Schulte, Loyd Trimmer, Ji-Eun Kim, Andrew Gulley and David Pineault of the National Minerals Information Center as one CSV of about 190 KB with XML metadata, downloadable and free under CC0 1.0, with global coverage by country. Caveats: capacities are estimates from public company and government information, only eight commodities are covered, and the method for planned projects is in the report, not on the page read. For simulation it gives near-term supply capacity by producing country for mineral supply shock and disruption scenarios, and for testing whether planned capacity meets demand from energy and electronics manufacturing. Related catalogue records include the USGS mineral commodity supply risk data, the EV battery cathode material flows and the BGS World Mineral Statistics.
